new_public_evidence.source: Maurer and Pontil, Empirical Bernstein Bounds and Sample Variance Penalization (2009)
new_public_evidence.result: Provides the bounded-variable empirical Bernstein inequality used for a fixed-cell simultaneous Monte Carlo lower-confidence screen.

derived_results.claim: For fixed sufficient statistics (y,W), exact minimization/maximization of p_theta over a rectangular mu/log-sigma cell is closed form because the farthest/nearest mu determines A=W+m(y-mu)^2 and sigma likelihood is unimodal with optimum sqrt(A/m). Dividing by the exact shared p_rho yields pointwise Rmin/Rmax without independent W bounds.

The pointwise H_mu minimum over a theta cell is also closed form. L=Rmin*Hmin if Hmin>=0 and L=Rmax*Hmin if Hmin<0 is a uniform lower envelope for R_theta H_theta over the entire cell. This eliminates the r88/r89 W-tail dependency blow-up.

On an independent 300000-sample q stream, with 16x16 theta cells, cap X=min(L,100), old analytic global lower range -16898.31, Maurer-Pontil one-sided empirical Bernstein at total delta=1e-6 gives all 256 simultaneous lower confidence bounds >0; worst=13.593588 at mu in [0.0992139,h], sigma in [ell,0.9427723].

For fixed theta,y, R(W)=B/[A exp(-(b-a)W)+C exp((a-c)W)], so the W maximizing ratio is obtained from the closed-form minimum of a decreasing-plus-increasing exponential denominator. Numerical compact optimization over the negative-curvature region gives max R about 3.81551; this is not yet interval-certified and was not used as the validation range assumption.

negative_or_scope_evidence: The simultaneous >13.59 result is randomized validation, not deterministic directed-rounding integration.
Ordinary binary64/scipy arithmetic was used in the sampler and pointwise envelope implementation.
The tighter max-ratio≈3.81551 compact optimization remains engineering evidence only; the validation conservatively retained the older analytic ratio envelope 461.24628.
All results remain restricted to the standardized frozen m=32 NIG predictor and iid Gaussian null rectangle.

candidate_new.mechanism: Replace huge y/W interval boxes by exact pointwise optimization over only the candidate-parameter cell, leaving the shared mixture denominator and W value coupled. Then integrate one sign-safe lower envelope under the known predictive q. This turns the mean-curvature proof into a low-dimensional expectation-certification problem with large observed positive margin.
candidate_new.status: exact envelope derived; strong simultaneous randomized screen passed; deterministic interval expectation proof pending
